title: NO DOWNED LABEL THROUGH THE WALLS
why: Parked by the raid text audit of 2026-10-09. Machines fight pillagers anywhere on the surface, and when one went down the NAME DOWNED label printed over him wherever he was, readable through walls, telling you where a man lay. The PICKED UP label for a crew revive did the same. Both now show only when you could actually see him, as the ELIMINATED label always has.
now: The DOWNED and PICKED UP labels over pillagers show only when you can see him, not through walls.

edits.replacement: if(!G.sim&&G.player&&canSee(G.player.x,G.player.y,G.player.face,TG.x,TG.y,G.vseg)){ label(TG.x,TG.y-18,'PICKED UP','#ffc04a',0,true); }   // v23.17: only a pick-up he could see
